notes.title: Elves of Duty Demo Livestream
notes.notes:
[h3]Elves of Duty is back for the final livestream of Steam Next Fest![/h3]

[h3]Download the free demo and let us know what you think of the game in the chat![/h3]

[h3]Have a crazy idea for a new power-up or level? Come share it with the community and help make Elves of Duty even better![/h3]
